highly crystalline MoSe2 multilayer thin films can be grown by CVD and the MoSe2 TFT shows a fast photodetector performance.
we have demonstrated the first CVD-grown MoSe2 thin film transistor (TFT) with multilayers for fast photodetector.

the CVD growth of multilayered MoSe2 and their application in TFTs and photodetectors.
a new approach to grow highly crystalline multilayer MoS2 by CVD and to demonstrate the potential of multilayer CVD-MoS2 for photodetectors.

the growth, characterization and applications of MoSe2 multilayers, which will provide useful information on the growth of high-quality MoSe2 thin films and their potential applications in electronic devices.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the CVD-grown MoSe2 multilayers are suitable for high-performance TFTs for photodiodes and photoconductors.

we have successfully demonstrated that CVD-grown MoSe2 multilayer TFTs have a high field-effect mobility of 10 cm2 V−1 s−1, a high photoresponsitivity of 93.7 AW−1, and a fast photo response time of 0.4 seconds, which is a promising candidate for future photodetector application.
we have developed a high-performance MoSe2 TFT for photodetectors by using a high-pressure CVD growth technique.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the high-quality CVD-grown MoSe2 multilayer TFT with a high mobility can be used for fast photodetector.
we have developed a new method to synthesize highly crystalline CVD-growth multilayer MoS2, MoSe2, and MoSSe by using high-pressure CVD.
the high crystallinity and the p-type-dominance in our MoSe2 TFT would be a key factor for the fast and high-performance MoSe2 photodetector.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the CVD growth of MoSe2 multilayers can be used to fabricate a highly crystalline MoSe2-based device.
a relatively high pressure can be used to achieve highly crystalline multilayer MoS2 thin films by chemical vapor deposition, which can be further applied to the growth of other 2D materials.
